Welcome to the Bascom-Turner online store. For more than 30 years, Bascom-Turner has been a leader in the design and manufacture of gas detection instruments and related products. More information about our company and our products is available on our main site, which can be reached by clicking Home on the menu bar above. All Bascom-Turner gas detectors, accessories and replacement parts are available for online purchase. Gases, which require special shipping and handling procedures, can be ordered by phone at 800-225-3298 or 781-769-9660, or by fax to 781-769-2099. Please note that Bascom-Turner gas detectors and accessories are typically built-to-order and may have up to an 8-week lead-time. If you need an order expedited, please call our office and we will do our best to accommodate your request. We hope you will find our online store a convenient way to view and purchase our products.
